48.original: The House Manderville alchemist can readjust your Manderville weaponry attributes.

49.original: If you are unhappy with your armament's properties or simply wish to experiment, I shall gladly readjust its aetherial pathways for you.

51.original: Readjust the attributes of your Manderville weaponry.

52.original: Learn about readjusting Manderville weaponry attributes.

54.original: The three attributes you added to your Manderville weaponry can be reselected or rebalanced. As with the initial augmentation, one of these attributes will be set to a lower value than the other two.

55.original: The three attributes you added to your Manderville weaponry can be reselected or rebalanced. As with the previous augmentation, one of these attributes will be set to a lower value than the other two.

56.original: Once you have readjusted the values to your liking, select “Confirm” to finalize your decision.

57.original: Resetting your weaponry's attributes will require an additional chunk of amplifying achondrite, so consider your choices carefully.

58.original: Resetting your weaponry's attributes will require an additional chunk of cosmic crystallite, so consider your choices carefully.

59.original: The weaponry you currently have equipped is not eligible for readjustment. You must equip the Manderville weaponry you wish to readjust before speaking with the House Manderville alchemist.

60.original: Ahem, do you happen to have any more achondrite stashed away? A single chunk is all I require, but it is a rather crucial element...

61.original: Chunks of amplifying achondrite can be obtained from Jubrunnah at the aetheryte plaza in Radz<hex:021F0103>at<hex:021F0103>Han.

62.original: Ahem, do you happen to have any more crystallite stashed away? A single chunk is all I require, but it is a rather crucial element...

63.original: Chunks of cosmic crystallite can be obtained from Jubrunnah at the aetheryte plaza in Radz<hex:021F0103>at<hex:021F0103>Han.

64.original: I'm sorry, but I'm afraid the readjustment process is only available for Manderville weaponry. If you might equip suitable armaments before we begin...?

65.original: There we are: perfectly adjusted to your newly stated preferences. Should you have further need of my alchemical manipulations, I shall be stationed here in the High Crucible for the foreseeable future.

66.original: Your Manderville weaponry (<hex:020837E3E94509FF1202280EFF09436C6173734A6F62E9450103FF1E02081AE1E94513FF1202280EFF09436C6173734A6F62E9450103FF010303>) has been readjusted.
